verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v1: lil-ʿāshiqīna liwāhiju lam yashfihā ʾillā ṣ-ṣalātu ʿalā n-nabiyyī muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v2: him fī jamāli muḥammidi tabṣur sanā mā n-nūru ʾillā fī jamāli muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v3: wāsluk sabīla muḥammadi tarshud bihi mā r-rushdu ʾillā fī sabīli muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v4: waz-zam madīḥa muḥammadi ḥubbā tafuz mā l-fawzu ʾillā fī madīḥi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v5: wāsrud khiṣāla muḥammadi tafkhar bihā mā l-fakhru ʾillā fī khiṣāli muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v6: wāṭlub bijāhi muḥammadi mā tabtaghī mā khāba man yadʿū bijāhi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v7: wānhaḍ liqabri muḥammadi tasʿad bihi saʿida lladhī yadnū liqabri muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v8: wāthbit lidhāti muḥammadi mā shiʾita min sharafi fasirru s-sirri dhātu muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v9: wādhkur ṣifāta muḥammadi mutasājilā ḥaqqa t-tasājuli fī ṣifāti muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v10: wath-tham ḍarīḥa muḥammadi waniʿālahi satafūzu ʾin taltham ḍarīḥa muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v11: wāʿrif maqāma muḥammadi tazdad bihi ḥubbā famā ʾasnā maqāma muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v12: wānʿim bidhikri muḥammadi qalba sh-shajī lā shajwa fī qalbi bidhikri muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v13: wāṣrif liwajhi muḥammadi ʿayna l-ḥashā yuḥyī l-baṣāʾira qaṣdu wajhi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v14: wākhliṣ līʾāli muḥammadi ḥubbā tarā ʿayna l-hudā fī ḥubbi ʾāli muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v15: wāḥzan limawti muḥammadi wawafātihi man dhā lladhī lam yabki mawta muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v16: ʾinnī khadīmu muḥammadi waʿubayduhu ḥasbī biʾan ʾudʿā khadīma muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v17: habnī liḥubbi muḥammadi yā rabbanā lam nakhsha min hawli biḥḥubi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v18: ʾaslamtu wajhī lladhī faṭara s-samā waʾatā l-ʿulā wal-ʾarḍa rabbi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v19: wawaqaftu ʿinda l-bābi wafqaha khāḍiʿi mutawassilā mustashfiʿā bimuḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v20: ʾinnī kathīru dh-dhanbi mā lī ḥīlatu qaddamtu bayna yadayyā madḥa muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v21: faʿasā yuthābu ʿalā bni mursiyati bimā yarjū mina l-mawlā bijāhi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v22: ṣallā ʿalayhi llāhu mā raqamat yadu washyā ṣ-ṣaḥāʾifi min thanāʾi muḥammadi
verses.lil-ashiqina-liwahijun-c1-v23: wal-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi maʿ ʾazwājihi wamani nṭawā yawmā līʾāli muḥammadi
